card1.title: Google Gemini
card1.body: Bring Gemini-powered AI into your product. Stream completions, route prompts, and ship faster.

card2.title: Replit
card2.body: Spin up dev environments, share runnable demos, and collaborate on code in seconds.

card3.title: Mistral AI
card3.body: Open-weight LLMs with strong tool-use. Self-host or call the hosted API from one client.

card4.title: VSCodium
card4.body: Telemetry-free fork of VS Code. Extension-compatible, MIT-licensed, ships everywhere.

card5.title: MediaWiki
card5.body: Sync with Wikipedia-style knowledge bases. Versioned pages, talk threads, and citations.

card6.title: Google PaLM
card6.body: Long-context reasoning at Google scale. Fine-tuning, embeddings, and structured output.
